name: Bookkeeping clerk
description: Processes accounts payable and expense reimbursements (APQC 9.6): matches each bill and expense claim to a spend line and a receipt, codes it and queues it for payment, and reconciles the corporate cards.

onet.title: Bookkeeping, Accounting, and Auditing Clerks
onet.basis: APQC 9.6 is accounts payable, expense reimbursements and corporate cards, routine posting and checking of financial records that O*NET describes for bookkeeping, accounting and auditing clerks; chosen over the --complete suggestions, which are credit roles.
